blocks.html: Alias configuration for a joiner service entry point.

types.name: name
types.description: The alias name or list of alias names for the service entry point.

types.name: entity
types.description: The entity name associated with this alias.

types.name: filterable
types.description: The list of fields that can be used as filters when querying through this alias.

types.name: __internal
types.description: Internal-only alias metadata used by the query layer.

children.name: crossjoinable
children.description:
Non-computed DML fields that can be used in cross-module SQL joins.
Used as an optimization layer to determine which fields are safe to
push into EXISTS-based cross-module filters.

children.name: tableName
children.description:
Physical table name (without PG schema) backing the alias entity.
Required to build cross-module SQL joins against the entity's table.

children.name: schema
children.description: PG schema of the entity's table, when the DML definition specifies one.

children.name: relations
children.description:
Module-internal DML relations of the alias entity, keyed by property
name. Used to traverse own-model hops when building cross-module SQL
joins (e.g. cart -> items -> product).

children.name: foreignKeyOwner
children.description:
Which side of the relation holds the foreign key column: `self`
for belongsTo, `target` for hasMany.

types.name: args
types.description: Extra arguments to pass to the remoteFetchData callback
